title: Slice rank of tensor subspaces over any field is bounded by (d/2+1) times its rank over the algebraic closure
author: Qiyuan Chen and Ke Ye
source_version: Published Discrete Analysis 2025:27, 29 pp., 17 December 2025; DOI 10.19086/da.145807; exact arXiv 2409.04034v4 PDF byte-matches saved published original
difficulty_reason: The result requires one common slice span for an entire tensor subspace, rather than separate low-rank decompositions of individual elements. The author builds a paired-block tensor and proves the reverse equality by a prime-ideal/Nullstellensatz evaluation and matrix-rank contradiction. The separately stated Derksen descent inequality closes the argument only after that complete new encoding is established.
work: Stability of Ranks under Field Extensions
